A data directory written by the released Keryx 0.5.1 binary: three uploads
across two drafts. `manifest.tsv` is `object_key`, `content_hash` and
`file_size` exactly as 0.5.1 recorded them in `draft_versions`.

Do not regenerate or edit these files. The point of the fixture is that a
newer Keryx reads what 0.5.1 wrote, in place.
